what_it_is: Surveillance and Monitoring of Mechanisms Installed under "Guiding Principles for Underwater Infrastructure Defence Exchanges"

sections.label: Submarine cable disruptions and Singapore connectivity
sections.summary: Most submarine cable disruptions worldwide come from accidental fishing and anchoring damage, but Singapore's connectivity stays resilient through diverse connections.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Globally, most submarine cable disruptions result from accidental damage caused by fishing and anchoring activities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Industry data indicates about 100 to 200 such incidents occurring worldwide each year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Singapore's international connectivity has nevertheless remained resilient due to the diversity and volume of our connections to other countries.

sections.label: Digital Connectivity Blueprint and cable operator obligations
sections.summary: The 2023 Digital Connectivity Blueprint aims to double submarine cable landings in 10 years, with operators required to monitor, report and repair faults.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Through the Digital Connectivity Blueprint that we launched in 2023, we had indicated that Singapore is committed to provide landing space and resources to enable submarine cable landings to double within the next 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The second is that we also work closely with the industry and we require cable operators to monitor cables for faults, report them within an hour of detection and ensure speedy repairs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: That is one of the obligations that we have placed on our cable operators, even though some of the cuts may be outside our territorial waters, but those obligations still apply on our cable operators.

sections.label: GUIDE agreement on underwater infrastructure security
sections.summary: GUIDE lets defence establishments of agreeing countries collaborate on critical underwater infrastructure security; 17 countries including Singapore signed it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Lastly, on the point of GUIDE, I just to add on that GUIDE brings countries which agree on shared principles and potential areas of defence, where defence establishments could collaborate on enhancing the security of critical underwater infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: It has been signed by 17 countries, including Singapore, and we will continue to work closely with countries that have expressed interest to sign up.
